description: GLASS Dataset: Generative-AI Large-customer Smart-meter Samples is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Nan Lin, Jacco Heres. This dataset contains synthetic daily load profiles for large-customer smart meters, produced by a flow-matching generative model. Each row represents a single day of a single synthetic sample: 96 power values at 15-minute resolution (in kW), conditioned on customer category, generation type, scenario, and consumption/generation level. Coverage: national (NL); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. Formats: Parquet. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
